Subtitles.Static: Welcome to Avalon, Trent. I oversee ship parking here. Do you need a berth?

Here are the terms. Check the price, and confirm if you're ready to proceed.
The terms look good. I'll take one berth.
Payment received. Your berth on Avalon is registered. You can park a ship there now.
Let's hold off on the purchase.
All right. What else would you like to know?
What are the rules for storing ships here?
A berth is yours permanently. It stays yours when you collect the ship. Your current ship doesn't take up a berth.
Can I use that berth at other bases too?
No. I can only register berths on Avalon. You'll need to make separate arrangements on another planet or station.
What happens when all my berths are occupied?
You won't be able to park another ship. You can still collect a stored ship or swap it with your current one. A swap doesn't need an empty berth.
You don't have enough credits. No payment was taken. Come back when you have the funds.

Goodbye, Trent. Safe flying.
Back on Avalon, Trent? I can help you with parking your ships.
